title: Modules & Transitive Moons
summary: Sun compiles reusable libraries into `.moon` files. Dependencies are transitive at the bitcode level but opaque at the symbol level: `main` sees `moon1`, but not the `moon2`/`moon3` symbols that `moon1` pulls in. The chain `main -> moon1 -> moon2 -> moon3` computes `1 + 2 + 3 = 6`.
